hierarchy.notes: Interactive score instrument driven by the production Vibe Score receipt formula with trust permanently quarantined from score.

classification.notes: The route creates bounded synthetic profiles in memory and copies a share line; it does not load, write, rank, or publish user data.

ssa_v2.notes: Server route, production-formula model, client controls, styles, and tests are separated and every owned file is below 310 lines.

ssi.notes: One typed score input drives the production receipt, factor bars, formula ledger, presets, and share line.

sstf.notes: Focused formula and layout contracts plus the complete 662-test clean release gate pass on the current implementation.

spe.notes: Six bounded numeric inputs generate at most ten providers, ninety daily rows, five trust signals, and five score factors.

srs.notes: Trust is labelled NOT USAGE and +0 score, clipboard failures are visible, and the page states that it performs no writes.

ssra.notes: Clean production build, preview and production deploys, mobile/desktop/4K layout, real slider and clipboard interactions, network, console, and zero-write proof pass.

sas.notes: The route, model, client surface, styles, and focused test have explicit owned and public boundaries.

sva.notes: No privileged client, secret, user record, mutation, provider call, or network request is present.

srls.notes: The brick does not access a database.

sev.notes: The brick requires no environment variables.

ssc.notes: Next and React are inherited from the web package and no dependency was added.

sai.notes: Lease, intent, source commit, decision, and touched paths are recorded.

code_budget.notes: The former 700-line static route is now a 13-line server surface with a production-formula model, focused client instrument, split route-local CSS, and contract test.

verification.command: focused score tests + pnpm sma:release-gate + pnpm audit --audit-level high + pnpm --dir packages/web build
verification.notes: 9 focused formula tests, 15 control-plane tests, 490 package tests, strict VTRS, TypeScript, dependency audit, clean 21-route Next build, Netlify interactions, and Lighthouse proof passed.

verification.command: focused Score/Wizard tests + pnpm sma:release-gate + pnpm --filter @vibetracker/web build + preview/production Playwright
verification.notes: 4 focused route/formula tests, 15 control-plane tests, 662 package tests, strict VTRS, TypeScript, and the 30-route Next build passed in an isolated clean worktree. Preview 6a5708a9bb4e157bfef5575c and production 6a570a661e54f47fbb88f84f prove unchanged mobile/desktop behavior and a centered 2640px 4K Score command center with 240px, 1499px, and 899px channels. A real input transition moved the score from 79 to 0 while trust remained +0, the receipt reached copied, and the page emitted zero write requests.

install_steps: Connect the score model only through buildVibeScoreReceipt.
Run focused formula and route tests plus the release gate.
known_traps: Trust context must never change score, spend, usage, or rank.
The simulator must not imply that it mutates a real profile.
Factor values and tiers must come from the production formula.

created_by.summary: Replaced the static score theatre with an interactive production-formula instrument.
created_by.intent: Make Vibe Score useful, visually precise, and fully inspectable without mutating real data.
created_by.decision_rationale: A bounded sample model feeding the production receipt function is the honest way to make the score interactive.
